_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 3% base rate for meaningful moves over 12h windows combined with exhausted ETF flows and a VIX at 62 means this market is coiled — HOLD is the statistically honest call until either fuel arrives (ETF inflows) or forced selling flushes weak hands.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing the coil and missing fuel, while the narrative writer implies a directional recovery is imminent; the analyst's higher trust weight (7.67 vs 6.00) and the base-rate evidence both favor the HOLD read.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive above 20 with funding dropping below 0.003% and VIX breaking below 16 — then UP toward Disbelief
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows stay at 0 or turn negative, funding rises above 0.006%, or BTC breaks below $60k on volume expansion — then DOWN to Panic
